title: RuleManifest
description: Static metadata describing a rule and how to fix violations of it.

NotFix.title: NotFix
NotFix.description: A remediation that looks like a fix but trips a different rule.

pattern.description: Short description of the tempting non-fix, e.g. "widen to unknown".

because.description: Why it does not actually solve the problem.

rule.description: The rule id this non-fix would trip, when there is one.

RuleGuidance.title: RuleGuidance
RuleGuidance.description: The explanatory half of a rule — everything a human or agent needs to fix it.

summary.description: One line. Shown inline with the violation.

why.description: Why the rule exists. Reasoning, not restatement.

notFixes.description: Dead-end remediations that should not be used.

bad.description: Example of code that violates the rule.

good.description: Example of code that satisfies the rule.

examples.description: Concrete bad and good examples for the rule.

RuleManifest.title: RuleManifest
RuleManifest.description: Full static metadata for a rule, including guidance and execution scope.

category.description: Free-form grouping for report output, e.g. "type-safety".

pack.description: The rule pack this rule ships in, e.g. "core-ts". Configuration enables rules by pack, so pack membership must be discoverable from the static manifest — otherwise packs: ["core-ts"] expands to nothing and silently enables no rules at all.

scope.description: Whether the rule examines one file or needs the whole project.

severity.description: Default severity. Configuration may override it.

evidence.description: What kind of evidence this rule's findings rest on. 'semantic' means the analyzer consulted a type system or symbol table; 'syntax' means it matched shape alone. Severity is deliberately not the lever for this: severity measures impact, this measures confidence, and they are independent. Omitted means unspecified, not semantic — an analyzer that has not considered the question should not be assumed to hold the stronger claim.

optionsSchema.description: JSON Schema for this rule's options, when it takes any.
